key_insight: Potential-energy landscapes and statistical sampling provide a unified framework connecting established materials theories with modern AI-driven discovery.
engineering_relevance: This framework can help practitioners choose and integrate simulation methods, high-throughput workflows, and AI tools for materials design.
method: Connect force fields, density-functional theory, and many-body methods through energy landscapes and sampling.
Review high-throughput workflows, materials databases, and probabilistic AI foundations.
Explain atomistic representations, graph neural networks, and generative models using symmetry and related mathematics.
evidence_signal: The abstract describes a pedagogical monograph informed by the author's research experience, without reporting datasets, benchmarks, or quantitative validation.
watch_item: The overview does not establish application-specific accuracy or reliability; selected methods still require validation for the target material and property.
paper_title: A Practitioner's Guide to Materials Theory and Computation in the Age of Big Data and Artificial Intelligence
